name: Authorization-code OAuth
tagline: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE for the optional provider type
description: Wires OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE (authorize_url, token_url, client_id, scopes) for the optional provider type. Provides the oauth feature only. Install the matching provider-type extension alongside it for headers, tools and client signature. Endpoints and scopes are supplied by this JSON — the gateway does not hardcode them.
author: aurora

oauth.scopes: org:create_api_key user:profile user:inference user:sessions:claude_code user:mcp_servers user:file_upload

settings.oauth_scopes: org:create_api_key user:profile user:inference user:sessions:claude_code user:mcp_servers user:file_upload

notes: Authorization-code + PKCE (S256). Paste CODE#STATE or the full callback URL after the browser redirects to localhost.
Pairs with a provider-type extension for base_url, headers and tools.
Review third-party extensions before installing them from a store.

ui.help: OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE for the optional provider type. Endpoints come from this extension — no hardcoded core origins.
